shots.name: Launch Button
shots.notes: There is no plunger rod — a button on the lockdown bar drops the ball into the bumper area. Tip-Off is lit as the skill shot if you have not collected it yet.

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: Take this one and the ball climbs a very shallow ramp, loops the top, and drops you back at the right inlane. With In The Paint lit, this is where you begin it; with the lamp dark, the same shot starts the Alley-Oop combo instead. Under-hit it and the ball ends up in the saucer area beneath the basket.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Short mid-field ramp back to the left inlane. A diverter can send it all the way to the top and around to the basket instead. Can be lit for a three-pointer, and collects the Slam Dunk combo.

shots.name: Center Ramp
shots.notes: Dead centre and always feeds the basket. Much safer from a trapped ball than a live one — a shot that stalls halfway up comes back down the middle and is the main drain of the game.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Short ramp back to the right inlane. Starts both the Slam Dunk and Fast Break combos.

shots.name: Right Lane
shots.notes: Starts In The Paint when lit there, otherwise starts the Tip-Off combo. Also the main way to feed the bumpers, which is how Power Hoops modes get started.

shots.name: Left Saucer
shots.notes: Crazy Bob's concessions live here, and so does every extra ball in the game. The hardest of the major shots to hit cleanly.

shots.name: The Basket
shots.notes: The hoop, and where most of your scoring happens. The centre ramp and the top saucers both deliver into it every time; the left ramp only does so with the diverter raised. Watch for the magnet sitting below it, which can grab and hold the ball.

shots.name: Four Top Saucers
shots.notes: An arc of four numbered saucers under the basket. Land in one and it fires the ball up a wireform into the hoop. Collecting all four numbers is what starts Around The World.

shots.name: Bumpers
shots.notes: Three of them, and they are the only way to advance Power Hoops. How much you enjoy this game depends heavily on how lively these are on your machine.

shots.name: Bumper Exit Lane
shots.notes: The lane between the centre and right ramps where balls come back down from the bumpers. Shooting up it is a cheap way to buy a few extra bumper hits.

shots.name: Inbounds Pass Targets
shots.notes: Two standups below the right lane entrance. Hit both to light Inbounds Pass at the left outlane.

shots.name: 3-P-T Targets
shots.notes: Three purple standups. Completing them lights a three-point basket at the left and centre ramps. You will never aim at these deliberately — they get hit on rebounds.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Lights In The Paint at the opposite side of the playfield, which is the right lane.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Lights In The Paint at the left orbit. Also where the left orbit and right ramp return the ball.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Where a lit Inbounds Pass saves you — the ball comes back from the launch lane instead of ending the ball.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Lights for the Million Dollar Shot on your last ball. Draining here then becomes a deliberate move rather than a mistake.

shots.name: Backglass Hoop
shots.notes: A real flipper and a real ball on the backglass. It fires by itself at various points in a game, but you only get to control it during Pizza.

shots.name: Shoot Button
shots.notes: Fires the ball from a top saucer at the hoop during In The Paint, and takes your foul shots when the game prompts you. Ignore the prompt and you do not get the point.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the right ramp and right lane. Also passes the ball between top saucers during In The Paint.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the left orbit, left ramp and left saucer. Trap here before you attempt the centre ramp.

goals.title: Tip-Off Skill Shot
goals.summary: The start of every ball lights Tip-Off, which is one of the four combos, so your skill shot and your first task both come from the same shot. The ball drops into the bumpers, so all you need is a centre ramp once it comes down.

steps.action: Press the launch button so the ball drops into the bumpers
steps.detail: Tip-Off is already lit unless you have collected it earlier in the game — there's no plunger to feather, just a lock-down-bar button that releases the ball straight into the bumper area.
Take it from a trapped ball if you can — the centre ramp is the main drain shot when it is missed.

goals.title: The Six Tasks
goals.summary: Everything in this game points at one thing: complete six tasks and Trophy Multiball starts on its own. Scoring is deliberately small — 300 points is an outstanding game — so think of tasks as the objective and points as the by-product.
instructions: Goals — score a two-pointer, a three-pointer and a free throw.
20 Points — reach 20 points. This one is spotted for you after your first Trophy Multiball.
Concessions — play all four of Crazy Bob's Stadium Goodies modes.
Multiballs — finish both Shoot Around and Around The World.
Power Hoops — start all four Power Hoops modes. You only have to start them, not complete them.
Once the sixth task falls, Trophy Multiball begins by itself. If you drain first it waits for your next ball.

goals.title: Goals: Two, Three And A Free Throw
goals.summary: The simplest task on the list. You need one two-point basket, one three-point basket and one free throw. The free throw is free — any basket with nothing else lit on it is worth a point.

steps.detail: That lights a three-pointer at the left and centre ramps.
With the diverter up, the left ramp carries all the way round to the hoop.
The basket is lit for a free throw whenever nothing else is lit on it, in modes and multiballs alike.

goals.title: The Four Combos
goals.summary: Four two-shot combos worth 2 points each. Start one and you have a few seconds and a handful of switches to finish it. Getting all four completes a task and lights an extra ball the first time.
goals.reward: 2 points each, extra ball for all four

steps.action: Tip-Off: right lane into the centre ramp
steps.detail: The right lane starts it whenever In The Paint is not lit there.

steps.action: Slam Dunk: right ramp into the left ramp
steps.detail: The right ramp is always lit to start this one.

steps.action: Alley-Oop: left orbit into the centre ramp
steps.detail: Only available when In The Paint is not lit at the orbit.

steps.action: Fast Break: either ramp into the centre ramp
steps.detail: Left or right ramp starts it. Combos are dead during Power Hoops and Concessions modes, so collect them in clean single-ball play.

goals.title: Crazy Bob's Concessions
goals.summary: The left saucer serves four modes in a fixed order: Pizza, Hot Dog, NBA Trivia and Egyptian Soda. Playing all four completes the Concessions task, and these modes are where the real points in this game live.
goals.reward: One of six tasks, and the biggest scores on the machine

steps.detail: Available any time in single-ball play unless a Concessions mode is already running.

steps.action: Work through all four in order
steps.detail: After Egyptian Soda times out the task is complete, and the saucer is still worth a point per visit afterwards.

goals.title: Pizza
goals.summary: Look up. For about ten seconds you control the backglass flipper and shoot a real ball at a backglass hoop whose value cycles between 1, 2 and 3 points. Time your flips to land on 3 and this single mode can be worth more than a whole ball of ordinary play.

steps.detail: Pizza is the first Concessions mode of the game.

steps.action: Watch the value, not the ball
steps.detail: The hoop alternates 1, 2 and 3 points — flip so the ball arrives on a 3.

steps.action: Save it for a late ball
steps.detail: If Pizza is lit on your last ball, take it. It is one of the few things worth going out of your way for.

goals.title: Hot Dog
goals.summary: A shot clock set to 24, which is about ten seconds. Any of the five major shots pays 3 points and resets the clock — but the reset value drops as you go, so the mode strangles itself. Twenty to thirty points is a good run.
goals.reward: 3 points a shot until the clock dies

steps.detail: Left orbit, left ramp and right ramp come round quickest and keep the clock alive.

steps.action: Do not hunt the centre ramp
steps.detail: A missed centre ramp both wastes the clock and threatens the ball.

goals.title: NBA Trivia
goals.summary: The display asks a basketball question and offers four answers. The right one is worth 10 points, a wrong one is worth 1. There is no shot to make and no risk to the ball, so trap up, read the whole question, then answer.

steps.detail: Third in the Concessions order.
You do not need to shoot anything during the question, so cradle and read.

goals.title: Egyptian Soda
goals.summary: The last of the four. Either outer ramp pays 3 points for about fifteen seconds. It is the least valuable of the concessions — if it is the only thing standing between you and Trophy Multiball, you can simply cradle and let it expire.

steps.detail: Left and right ramps both count; the centre ramp does not.
Timing it out still completes the Concessions task.

goals.title: Shoot Around Multiball
goals.summary: Hit all five major shots in any order to spell S-H-O-O-T and a two-ball multiball starts. The important thing inside it is to spell S-H-O-O-T again — that lights an extra ball — and every flashing shot is worth 2 points along the way.
goals.reward: 2 points per flashing shot, extra ball for a second S-H-O-O-T

steps.detail: Left orbit, left ramp, centre ramp, right ramp and right lane, in any order, during single-ball play.
The letters flash until collected, and completing the set again resets them and lights the extra ball.

goals.title: In The Paint
goals.summary: Cross an inlane and the opposite orbit or lane lights for about ten seconds. Shoot it and the ball drops into a top saucer with a plastic guard sliding toward you — pass between saucers with the flippers until you are clear, then shoot the hoop with the button.
goals.reward: A lit saucer number toward Around The World

steps.detail: The left inlane lights the right lane and the right inlane lights the left orbit. If it was lit at the start of a ball it stays lit until you use it.
In The Paint starting there kills that shot's Alley-Oop or Tip-Off lamp.
The flippers move the ball between the four saucers; a player who knows this should never get blocked.
The shot itself can still miss the hoop, and that ends the mode.

goals.title: Around The World Multiball
goals.summary: The four top saucers are numbered 1 to 4. Light all four and a three-ball multiball starts, with one major shot flashing for 1 point per ball in play. The flashing shots are not worth chasing — shoot free throws instead and bank progress toward the extra ball.

steps.detail: In The Paint lights one, and any ball that simply falls into a saucer collects that number for free.

steps.action: Shoot free throws, not the flashing shot
steps.detail: The flashing shot starts at the left orbit and steps right, but a point per ball is poor value next to stacking free throws.

goals.title: Power Hoops
goals.summary: Four modes started purely by bumper hits — typically at 11, 22, 33 and 44, though machines vary and the game lowers the requirement if you keep falling short. Three of them light a single ramp for 3 points; the fourth is a two-ball mode.
goals.reward: 3 points a shot, and one of six tasks

steps.detail: The right lane is the reliable way in, and each ball ejected from the basket adds a few hits on its way down.

steps.action: Half Court Hoops is the centre ramp
steps.detail: Roughly 20 seconds with one shot lit for 3 points.

steps.action: Hook Shot and Run & Shoot use the left ramp
steps.detail: Run & Shoot alternates the left and centre ramps.

steps.action: Only starts count for the task
steps.detail: You have to start all four, not finish them — so if the points are not there, let one expire and go back to the bumpers.

goals.title: Trophy Multiball
goals.summary: All six tasks done and it starts automatically. Unlimited balls for about twenty seconds with the centre ramp lit for 2 points, and one job: outscore the other team. Around six or seven shots does it. Win and you get a Ring.

steps.detail: It is the only shot lit, at 2 points a time, and with unlimited balls a miss costs you nothing but time.
The ball autoplunges the moment the mode finishes — there is no breather.
Every task except 20 Points resets, so you can win a second Ring in the same game.

goals.title: Rings Beat Points
goals.summary: This machine does not keep a normal high score table. Each of the 29 teams has its own champion score, and when scores are compared a Ring always outranks points — 150 with a Ring beats 200 without one.
goals.reward: Team Champion and Grand Champion entries

steps.detail: You are chasing that team's champion score, not a global table — and there is a separate Grand Champion for the best score on the machine overall.
A Ring outranks any number of points, so when you are one task from Trophy Multiball, go and get it.
There is no end-of-ball bonus anywhere in this game, so shaking a doomed ball costs you nothing at all.

goals.title: Four Ways To An Extra Ball
goals.summary: Nothing here is random, which is rare. The four routes are all four combos, respelling S-H-O-O-T inside Shoot Around Multiball, banking free throws, and grinding left orbit loop combos. Every extra ball lights at the left saucer and they stack without limit, so it is not hard to turn a three-ball game into five or six.
goals.reward: Extra balls at the left saucer

steps.detail: Lights an extra ball the first time you complete the set.
Ten free throws lights one on most machines, and some are set as low as three. This route only works once a game.

steps.action: Or grind left orbit loop combos
steps.detail: Two orbits back to back is one loop combo, and the target is commonly 22 — a long way to go for one ball.
Every lit extra ball waits here, and they queue up rather than overwriting each other.

goals.title: Inbounds Pass
goals.summary: Two standups under the right lane light a save at the left outlane. It returns the ball from the launch lane, and it works in modes as well. What it does not do is carry over — an unused pass is gone when the ball ends.

steps.detail: They sit below the right lane entrance, so right lane shots that come up short often clip them.
In multiball, using it usually means you cannot relight it until you are back to a single ball.

goals.title: Basket Compensation
goals.summary: A quiet piece of generosity that changes how you shoot. If you make the left or centre ramp but the ball misses the hoop, it usually drops into a top saucer — and that saucer will fire it into the basket and give you credit for whatever you were shooting for.
goals.reward: Credit for a missed hoop, plus the saucer number
instructions: The compensation only applies if the saucer fires reasonably soon after your ramp shot.
You also collect the 1-to-4 number for that saucer, which quietly advances Around The World.
This is why weak left orbit shots are not wasted — they fall into the saucers and pay anyway.
Knowing this makes the ramps worth shooting even when your aim at the hoop is unreliable.

goals.title: The Million Dollar Shot
goals.summary: On your last ball, or after your final extra ball, the right outlane lights. Drain there deliberately and another ball launches with about ten seconds to hit the basket from the centre ramp. Make it and your game continues; miss and it is over.
goals.reward: A million dollars and your game back

steps.action: Take the right drain on purpose
steps.detail: Nothing else lights this — it only appears on the last ball or after your final extra ball.
There is no compensation here — hitting the ramp but missing the hoop does not count.
If you are awarded an extra ball while it is lit, the shot switches off and relights on your next ball.

achievements.title: Tip-Off
achievements.desc: Collect the Tip-Off combo from the start of a ball.

achievements.title: Two, Three And One
achievements.desc: Score a two-pointer, a three-pointer and a free throw to complete the Goals task.

achievements.title: All Four Combos
achievements.desc: Complete Tip-Off, Slam Dunk, Alley-Oop and Fast Break in one game.

achievements.title: Nothing But Net
achievements.desc: Score a three-pointer on the backglass hoop during Pizza.

achievements.title: Ask Me Anything
achievements.desc: Answer an NBA Trivia question correctly for the full 10 points.

achievements.title: S-H-O-O-T Twice
achievements.desc: Spell S-H-O-O-T again inside Shoot Around Multiball to light the extra ball.

achievements.title: Past The Guard
achievements.desc: Pass between the top saucers and score In The Paint without being blocked.

achievements.title: Around The World
achievements.desc: Light all four saucer numbers and start Around The World Multiball.

achievements.title: Bumper Grinder
achievements.desc: Start all four Power Hoops modes in one game.

achievements.title: Win The Ring
achievements.desc: Complete all six tasks and outscore the other team in Trophy Multiball.

achievements.title: Million Dollar Shot
achievements.desc: Drain the lit right outlane and make the basket before the clock runs out.

drills.title: Tip-Off From A Trap
drills.text: Press the button, let the ball come back down out of the bumpers, and finish Tip-Off at the centre ramp — the skill shot and your first combo are the same thing here. Take it from a cradle rather than on the fly, because a centre ramp that stalls halfway comes straight back down the middle.
drills.reps: every ball until Tip-Off is banked, one full game

drills.title: All Four Combos, Clean Ball
drills.text: Right lane into the centre ramp, right ramp into the left ramp, left orbit into the centre ramp, either ramp into the centre ramp. Each pair has only a few seconds in it, and combos are dead during Power Hoops and Concessions — so collect the set in clean single-ball play.

drills.title: Pass Around The Guard
drills.text: Cross an inlane to light the opposite orbit or lane, shoot it, and then work the plastic guard sliding toward you: the flippers pass the ball between the four top saucers, so a player who knows that should never end up blocked. Move first and press the button second — the shot itself can still miss the hoop and end the mode.
drills.reps: 10 saucer visits, moving before every press

drills.title: Left Saucer Reps
drills.text: Every extra ball in the game waits at the left saucer, and it is the hardest of the major shots to hit cleanly. Feed it from the right flipper and play a ball taking nothing else — Crazy Bob's lives there too, which is where the real points on this machine are.
drills.reps: one full ball, left saucer only

drills.title: Keep The Shot Clock Alive
drills.text: The clock resets by less every time, so Hot Dog strangles itself unless you stay on the shots that come back quickest — left orbit, left ramp, right ramp. Leave the centre ramp alone during it: a miss there costs you the clock and threatens the ball at the same time.

drills.title: Bank The Pass Early
drills.text: The two standups under the right lane entrance light a save at the left outlane, and right lane shots that come up short clip them anyway. Take the pass at the start of every ball — it does not carry over, so an unused one is simply thrown away.
drills.reps: every ball, pass lit before anything else

actionButton.label: Shoot Button
actionButton.location: the big button in the middle of the lockdown bar
actionButton.how: There is no shooter rod on this machine at all — one button on the bar replaces it, and it keeps working long after the launch. The same press that puts a ball into play is the one that fires at the hoop from the top saucers and takes your free throws. Treat it as a shot you can make with your thumb.

uses.what: Drops the ball into the bumper area with Tip-Off lit, so the skill shot and your first combo are the same thing.
Fires at the hoop during In The Paint. Pass between saucers with the flippers first, then press once you are clear.

uses.when: The display calls a Foul Shot
uses.what: Takes the free throw for a point. Ignore the prompt and the point simply does not arrive.

uses.when: Chasing the Free Throw extra ball
uses.what: Ten free throws light it, so never let a prompted shot go unpressed during a long ball.

howItPlays.objective: NBA Fastbreak keeps score in real basketball points -- three hundred is a blowout -- so treat tasks, not points, as the goal. Finish six of them and Trophy Multiball starts on its own, where you play to win a Ring rather than to run up a number.
loop: There is no plunger: the lockbar button drops the ball into the bumpers, then later doubles as your shot at the hoop and your free throws.
Bank the simple Goals task first -- sink a deuce, a trey and a single free throw -- then sweep the four two-shot combos for an extra ball.
Score the actual points in Crazy Bob's concession modes and the two multiballs, Shoot Around and Around The World.
Feed the bumpers to trip the four Power Hoops modes -- starting each one is enough, since finishing is never required.
Land all six tasks and Trophy Multiball fires by itself -- outscore the opponent inside the clock to take home a Ring.

lights.name: The Four Combos
lights.lit: A lit combo-start shot opens a two-shot chain you have a few seconds to finish: the right lane feeds Tip-Off, the right ramp feeds Slam Dunk, the left orbit feeds Alley-Oop, either ramp feeds Fast Break. A combo only lights while In The Paint is not claiming that same shot.
lights.then: Finish all four to complete a task and light your first extra ball at the left saucer. Collect them in clean single-ball play, because combos go dead during Power Hoops and the concession modes.

lights.name: 3-P-T Targets
lights.lit: The three purple standups light as you complete them -- you clip them on rebounds rather than aim for them -- and finishing the set arms a three-point shot at both the left and the centre ramp.
lights.then: Cash the lit three-pointer up a ramp into the hoop to knock out part of the Goals task; the basket also counts a plain free throw any time nothing else is lit on it.

lights.name: S-H-O-O-T
lights.lit: Hitting the five major shots in any order lights the letters of S-H-O-O-T, and each lit letter is one you still owe. Spelling the word starts a two-ball multiball.
lights.flashing: Inside the multiball the five letters flash until re-collected -- respelling the whole word resets them and lights an extra ball.
lights.then: Every flashing shot pays a couple of points along the way, but the real prize is respelling the word during the multiball for that extra ball, and the whole feature ticks off a task.

lights.name: Four Top Saucers
lights.lit: The four numbered saucers under the hoop light as you gather 1 through 4 -- and any ball that simply drops into one claims that number for free, including a ramp shot that misses the hoop and falls in. Light all four to start a three-ball multiball.
lights.then: In Around The World the flashing shot pays only a point per ball, so ignore it and stack cheap free throws at the hoop instead -- both feed the extra ball, and it beats chasing the roving shot.

lights.name: In The Paint
lights.lit: Crossing an inlane lights the opposite shot for about ten seconds -- the left inlane lights the right lane, the right inlane lights the left orbit. Shoot the lit side and the ball is kicked up into one of the top saucers, where a plastic guard starts sliding across toward you.

control.effect: shuffle the ball across the four top saucers to slip clear of the sliding guard before you fire at the hoop
control.when: while the guard is closing in

lights.then: Once a saucer is clear, punch the lockbar button to fire at the hoop -- make it and you light one of the four saucer numbers toward Around The World. The button shot can still brick, and a brick ends the mode.

lights.name: Power Hoops
lights.lit: The three pop bumpers are the only way in -- roughly every eleven, twenty-two, thirty-three and forty-four hits arms the next Power Hoops mode, and the machine eases the count if you keep coming up short. Feed them through the right lane and the bumper exit lane.
lights.then: Three of the modes light a single ramp for three points apiece and the fourth is a two-ball affair, but only STARTING all four is needed to tick off a task -- so when a mode is not paying, let it time out and return to feeding the pops for the next one.

lights.name: Crazy Bob's Concessions
lights.lit: The left saucer lights to serve its four concession modes in one set sequence: Pizza to open, then Hot Dog, a round of NBA Trivia, and finally Egyptian Soda. It is also where every extra ball in the game waits, and Pizza even hands you the real flipper and ball on the backglass for about ten seconds.
lights.then: Play all four to complete a task and rake in the biggest points on the machine -- a well-timed Pizza alone can outscore a whole ball of ordinary play. The saucer still pays a point a visit once the set is done.

scoring.text: Bank the guaranteed stuff: the Tip-Off skill shot is already lit at the start of every ball, the Goals task wants just a deuce, a trey and one free throw, and the four combos light an extra ball. Remember a Ring beats any point total, and with no end-of-ball bonus a doomed ball is free to shake.

Chase the real points and the remaining tasks together -- run Crazy Bob's concession modes, trip all four Power Hoops off the bumpers, and close out both multiballs, Around The World and Shoot Around.

Complete all six tasks and Trophy Multiball starts by itself: roughly twenty seconds of unlimited balls with only the centre ramp lit for two points, and the lone task is to beat the opposing side for a Ring, which outranks any number of points on this machine. Every task but the points target resets afterward, so a second Ring is on the table.
